purpose: Define explicit mounting of modules, adapters and service surfaces into registered namespaces without transferring semantic ownership or creating hidden executable roots.

topics.name: Namespace Mounting
topics.purpose: Define explicit mounting of modules, adapters and service surfaces into registered namespaces without transferring semantic ownership or creating hidden executable roots.

semantics.mount_rule: Mount binds an explicit namespace/address to an explicit canonical owner/surface.
semantics.adapter_rule: Adapter mounts symbols/translations only and gains no independent execution authority.
semantics.module_rule: UserModule instances mount under their declared `#UM` identity/instance surface.
semantics.service_rule: Optional service/protocol roots expose declared service semantics but remain separate from transport binding state.
semantics.ownership_rule: Mount location does not transfer semantic ownership from mounted source.
semantics.unmount_rule: Unmount removes availability/binding, not the authoritative semantic definition unless lifecycle semantics explicitly delete it.
semantics.authority_rule: Mounting a writable/invokable surface does not bypass applicable authorization.

invariants.rule: Runtime symbol namespaces, roots, mounts and dynamic families are explicit, collision-free and never inferred solely from filesystem layout or display labels.

hard_gates.condition: adapter mount gains hidden command authority
namespace target inferred from filesystem path only
